what: Cross-mode specificity (P0.4.0): the grad-norm instrument must NOT fire on COLLAPSE. Reads the collapse (P0.2 SimSiam) PC arm's grad-norm trace, multi-seed replication of C2. Device=hpu, epochs=8 (enough to show the PC collapsing toward the -1 floor; the collapse GATE itself needs ~40 epochs and is not the point here).
reads: The collapsing PC keeps its grad norm BOUNDED (peak ~1.9-2.5) and FINITE (never non-finite) on every seed while its loss rides toward the -1 constant-solution floor (genuine collapse) -> grad norm does not fire on collapse, seed-robustly (n=1 -> n=3).
Peak ~2.5 is orders of magnitude below the divergence scale (>=1e5), so the instrument is specific to divergence vs collapse across seeds.
